newsitem.title: EGYPT: Heliopolis to give 10 pound dividend.
newsitem.headline: Heliopolis to give 10 pound dividend.

text.p: Heliopolis Housing and Development has decided to give a 10 pound dividend for the 1995/96 financial year and shareholders have suggested an extra pay-out of a free share for every two, company sources said on Thursday.
They said the firm decided the pay-out in its annual general meeting on Wednesday but the firm's board would decide on the free share issue at a later meeting.
Heliopolis Housing nearly doubled net after-tax profits in the financial year 1995/96 to 61.35 million pounds ($18 million) from 34.07 million in the previous year.

Of this profit, the firm said it would distribute 45.73 million pounds to shareholders compared to the 28.39 million pounds it gave out in 1994/95. This would have given shareholders a dividend equivalent to 9.25 pounds.
The financial year ends on June 30.

The Egyptian state said last month it was auctioning five percent or more of its majority stake in the part-privatised firm to at least one strategic investor but ended selling most of it through the bourse.
Brokers have also said privatised realty firm Medinet Nasr Housing and Development was selling some of its share in Heliopolis Housing through the bourse.
